title: Dark Client
description: Ever wanted all the perks of a premium client without juggling another launcher? With Custom Client, you get client-side features baked straight into your mods—performance boosts, HUD mods, and quality-of-life tweaks—loaded right alongside Fabric API

# Dark Client

Looking for a cleaner, more customizable Minecraft experience? **Dark Client** brings together a powerful collection of HUD modules, customization tools, and quality-of-life features in one lightweight package.

Whether you're a PvP player who needs important information at a glance or someone who loves personalizing every part of their game, Dark Client gives you complete control over your Minecraft interface.

## Fully Customizable HUD

Dark Client allows you to build your perfect HUD layout from the ground up.

Move, resize, and organize every module exactly where you want it. Create a minimal setup, a competitive PvP layout, or an information-packed display tailored to your playstyle.

### Available HUD Modules

Dark Client includes a growing collection of useful HUD elements, including:

* FPS Counter
* Ping Display
* Direction Indicator
* Keystrokes
* Armor Durability
* Coordinates
* CPS Counter
* Clock
* Speed Display
* Biome Information
* Session Statistics
* And much more

## HUD Organization

Managing your HUD has never been easier.

The built-in organization system allows you to quickly:

* Enable and disable modules
* Reposition HUD elements
* Create clean layouts
* Customize visibility settings
* Keep your screen clutter-free

Everything is designed to be intuitive and accessible directly from within Minecraft.

## Custom Panorama Selection

Give your Minecraft menu a completely new look.

Dark Client includes a customizable panorama system that lets you choose from multiple background panoramas for your main menu. Switch between different styles and create an experience that matches your preferences.

### Features

* Multiple panorama backgrounds
* Easy selection menu
* Instant preview support
* Personalized main menu appearance

## Built for Everyday Gameplay

Dark Client focuses on providing useful information without unnecessary clutter.

### Benefits

* Lightweight and optimized
* Clean modern interface
* Easy-to-use customization tools
* Useful HUD information at a glance
* Suitable for PvP, Survival, and Multiplayer
* Designed for both casual and competitive players

## Easy Customization

Every player uses Minecraft differently.

Dark Client allows you to customize your experience by choosing exactly which information you want displayed and where it appears on your screen.

Whether you need FPS and Ping for competitive gameplay or durability and coordinates for survival adventures, Dark Client adapts to your needs.

## Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader.
2. Install Fabric API.
3. Install Dark Client.
4. Launch Minecraft.
5. Open the Dark Client settings and start customizing.

No complicated setup required—just install and personalize your Minecraft experience.
